summary: This plugin adds an "Approve for me" session preset to DeepSeek Harness, applying one-time, rule and risk-based review to selected tool calls and deferring to the native human approval flow when automated review is not available.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This is primarily an automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that introduces a user-selectable managed approval preset to reduce manual prompts by reviewing certain tool calls automatically. It combines risk-based MCP classification, configurable tool rules, and one-shot grants with native fallbacks to human approval when reviewer outcomes are missing or failing, so it changes permission workflow rather than adding core content editing or data-processing features.
